name: Workday
description: This App is installed via automation.DO NOT DELETE since its shared.

search.queryText:
_sourceCategory = Labs/Workday* 
| json "requestTime", "ipAddress", "systemAccount", "taskDisplayName", "target.descriptor", "sessionId", "activityAction", "deviceType", "tenant_name" as Time, ipAddress, %"System User", Task, Target, SessionID, ActivityAction, %"Device Type", tenant_name nodrop
| parse field=Task "api/*" as %"API"
| if(isBlank(%"Device Type"),"Unknown", %"Device Type") as %"Device Type"
| if(%"API" matches "*GET*", "GET",  if(%"API" matches "*POST*", "POST", "OTHER")) as request_method
| where %"API" matches "{{API_URL}}" and %"System User" matches "{{SYSTEM_USER}}"
| request_method as %"Request Method"
| count by Time, %"System User", %"API", %"Request Method", %"Device Type", tenant_name
| sort by Time
| fields -_count

_sourceCategory = Labs/Workday* 
| json "requestTime", "ipAddress", "systemAccount", "taskDisplayName", "target.descriptor", "sessionId", "activityAction", "deviceType", "tenant_name"  as Time, ipAddress, %"System User", Task, Target, SessionID, ActivityAction, %"Device Type", tenant_name nodrop
| if(isBlank(%"Device Type"),"Unknown", %"Device Type") as %"Device Type"
| where  %"System User" matches "{{SYSTEM_USER}}"
| count by Time, %"System User", Task, Target, tenant_name
| sort by Time
| fields -_count

children.name: Workday - API Activity
children.description: The Workday - API Activity dashboard provides detailed graph and analytics for REST API calls and the web service logins. It also lists the details of recent and malicious API activities.
children.title: Workday - API Activity

queries.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/Workday*
| json  "ipAddress", "systemAccount", "taskDisplayName", "activityAction", "tenant_name" as ipAddress, %"System User", Task, ActivityAction, TenantName nodrop
| where !(%"System User" matches "wd-*") and ipAddress matches "{{IPAddress}}" and %"System User" matches "{{SystemUser}}" and Task matches "{{Task}}" and ActivityAction matches "{{ActivityAction}}" and TenantName matches "{{TenantName}}"
| parse field=Task "api/*" as api_url
| count as %"Count" by api_url
| sort by %"Count"

_sourceCategory = Labs/Workday*
| json  "ipAddress", "systemAccount", "taskDisplayName", "activityAction", "tenant_name" as ipAddress, %"System User", Task, ActivityAction, TenantName nodrop
| where !(%"System User" matches "wd-*") and ipAddress matches "{{IPAddress}}" and %"System User" matches "{{SystemUser}}" and Task matches "{{Task}}" and ActivityAction matches "{{ActivityAction}}" and TenantName matches "{{TenantName}}"
| parse field=Task "api/*" as api_url
| if(api_url matches "*GET*", "GET",  if(api_url matches "*POST*", "POST", "OTHER")) as request_method
| count as %"Count" by request_method
| sort by %"Count"

_sourceCategory = Labs/Workday*
| json  "ipAddress", "systemAccount", "taskDisplayName", "activityAction", "tenant_name" as ipAddress, %"System User", Task, ActivityAction, TenantName nodrop
| where !(%"System User" matches "wd-*") and ipAddress matches "{{IPAddress}}" and %"System User" matches "{{SystemUser}}" and Task matches "{{Task}}" and ActivityAction matches "{{ActivityAction}}" and TenantName matches "{{TenantName}}"
| parse field=Task "api/*" as api_url
| count by ipAddress
| top 10 ipAddress by _count
| _count as %"Count"
| fields -_count

_sourceCategory = Labs/Workday*
| json "requestTime", "ipAddress", "systemAccount", "taskDisplayName", "activityAction", "tenant_name" as Time, ipAddress, %"System User", Task, ActivityAction, TenantName nodrop
| where !(%"System User" matches "wd-*") and ipAddress matches "{{IPAddress}}" and %"System User" matches "{{SystemUser}}" and Task matches "{{Task}}" and ActivityAction matches "{{ActivityAction}}" and TenantName matches "{{TenantName}}"
| parse field=Task "api/*" as api_url
| timeslice 1h
| count by activityAction, _timeslice
| transpose row _timeslice column activityAction

_sourceCategory = Labs/Workday*
| json "ipAddress", "systemAccount", "taskDisplayName", "activityAction", "deviceType", "tenant_name" as ipAddress, %"System User", Task, ActivityAction, DeviceType, TenantName nodrop
|  where !(%"System User" matches "wd-*") and ipAddress matches "{{IPAddress}}" and %"System User" matches "{{SystemUser}}" and Task matches "{{Task}}" and ActivityAction matches "{{ActivityAction}}" and TenantName matches "{{TenantName}}" and (Task matches "*Web Service*" or Task matches "api/*")
| lookup type, actor, raw, threatlevel as malicious_confidence, threat from sumo://threat/cs on threat=ipAddress
| where type="ip_address" and !isNull(malicious_confidence)
| json field=raw "malware_families[*]" as threat_malware_families nodrop
| json field=raw "last_updated" as last_updated nodrop
| formatDate(fromseconds(last_updated), "MM-dd-yyyy") as %"Threat Last Updated" 
| json field=raw "labels[*].name" as label_name nodrop
| replace(label_name, "\\/","->") as label_name
| replace(label_name, "\""," ") as label_name
| where !(label_name matches "*TorProxy*")
| if (isEmpty(actor), "Unassigned", actor) as actor
| malicious_confidence as %"Malicious Confidence"
| ipAddress as %"Malicious IP"
| DeviceType as %"Device Type"
| actor as %"Malicious Actor"
| count as %"Count" by %"System User", %"Malicious IP", Task, %"Device Type", %"Malicious Actor", %"Malicious Confidence", %"Threat Last Updated"
| sort by %"Count"

_sourceCategory = Labs/Workday*
| json "Request_Originator", "System_Account", "Authentication_Type_for_Signon", "Session_IP_Address", "tenant_name" as %"Request Originator", %"System User", %"Authentication Type", session_ip_address, TenantName nodrop
| where  !(%"System User" matches "wd-*") and session_ip_address matches "{{IPAddress}}" and %"System User" matches "{{SystemUser}}" and %"Request Originator" = "Web Services" and TenantName matches "{{TenantName}}" 
| count as %"Count" by %"System User", %"Authentication Type"
| sort by %"Count"

_sourceCategory = Labs/Workday*
| json "requestTime", "ipAddress", "systemAccount", "taskDisplayName", "target.descriptor", "activityAction", "tenant_name" as Time, ipAddress, %"System User", Task, Target, ActivityAction, TenantName nodrop
| where !(%"System User" matches "wd-*") and ipAddress matches "{{IPAddress}}" and %"System User" matches "{{SystemUser}}" and Task matches "{{Task}}" and ActivityAction matches "{{ActivityAction}}" and TenantName matches "{{TenantName}}" and Task matches "*Web Service*"
| count by Time, %"System User", Task, Target
| sort by Time
| fields -_count

_sourceCategory = Labs/Workday*

children.name: Workday - Overview
children.description: The Workday - Overview dashboard gives a high-level view of the geo-locations of user login. The panel helps you in monitoring failed login by devices and the recent activities from untrusted devices.
children.title: Workday - Overview

queries.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/Workday* 
| json "System_Account", "Session_IP_Address", "tenant_name" nodrop
| where !(System_Account matches "wd-*") and Session_IP_Address matches "{{IPAddress}}" and tenant_name matches "{{TenantName}}" and System_Account matches "{{SystemUser}}" 
| count by Session_IP_Address
| lookup latitude, longitude, country_code, country_name, region, city, postal_code from geo://location on ip = Session_IP_Address
| count by latitude, longitude, country_code, country_name, region, city, postal_code
| sort _count

_sourceCategory = Labs/Workday* 
| json "System_Account", "Session_IP_Address", "Request_Originator","Failed_Signon", "tenant_name"  nodrop
| where !(System_Account matches "wd-*") and Session_IP_Address matches "{{IPAddress}}" and tenant_name matches "{{TenantName}}" and System_Account matches "{{SystemUser}}"
| timeslice 1h
| count by _timeslice
| outlier _count window=6, threshold=2
| where _count_std > 0
| if(_count_violation=1,abs(_count_error)/_count_std, 0) as deviation
| if(deviation >= 1, 1, 0) as total_logins_anomaly
| fields _timeslice, total_logins_anomaly //, _count_violation, _count_error, _count_std, deviation

_sourceCategory = Labs/Workday* 
| json "System_Account", "Session_IP_Address", "Request_Originator","Failed_Signon", "tenant_name"  nodrop
| where !(System_Account matches "wd-*") and Session_IP_Address matches "{{IPAddress}}" and tenant_name matches "{{TenantName}}" and System_Account matches "{{SystemUser}}"
| timeslice 1h
| where Failed_Signon=1
| count by _timeslice
| outlier _count window=6, threshold=2
| where _count_std > 0
| if(_count_violation=1,abs(_count_error)/_count_std, 0) as deviation
| if(deviation >= 1, 1, 0) as failed_logins_anomaly
| fields _timeslice, failed_logins_anomaly //, _count_violation, _count_error, _count_std, deviation

_sourceCategory = Labs/Workday* 
| json "ipAddress", "systemAccount", "taskDisplayName", "activityAction", "tenant_name"  as  ipAddress, %"System User", Task, ActivityAction, tenant_name nodrop
| where ipAddress matches "{{IPAddress}}" and tenant_name matches "{{TenantName}}" and !(%"System User" matches "wd-*") and %"System User" matches "{{SystemUser}}" and Task matches "{{Task}}" and ActivityAction = "DOWNLOAD"
| count by Task

_sourceCategory = Labs/Workday*

| where !(System_Account matches "wd-*") and Session_IP_Address matches "{{IPAddress}}" and tenant_name matches "{{TenantName}}" and System_Account matches "{{SystemUser}}" 
| where Failed_Signon=1
| count

| count by Time, %"System User", Task, Target

_sourceCategory = Labs/Workday* 
| json "requestTime", "systemAccount", "taskDisplayName", "target.descriptor", "activityAction", "tenant_name" as Time, %"System User", Task, Target, ActivityAction, tenant_name nodrop
| where Task matches "*API Client*" and (ActivityAction = "WRITE" or Task matches "*Edit*" or Task matches "*Delete*") and Task matches "{{Task}}" and tenant_name matches "{{TenantName}}" and %"System User" matches "{{SystemUser}}"
| count by Time, %"System User", Task, Target
| sort by Time
| fields -_count

_sourceCategory = Labs/Workday* 
| json "requestTime", "systemAccount", "taskDisplayName", "target.descriptor", "activityAction", "tenant_name" as Time, %"System User", Task, Target, ActivityAction, tenant_name nodrop
| where (Task matches "*Permissions*" or Task matches "*Credentials*") and (ActivityAction = "WRITE" or Task matches "*Edit*" or Task matches "*Delete*") and Task matches "{{Task}}" and tenant_name matches "{{TenantName}}" and %"System User" matches "{{SystemUser}}"
| count by Time, %"System User", Task, Target
| sort by Time
| fields -_count

_sourceCategory = Labs/Workday* 
| json "requestTime", "systemAccount", "taskDisplayName", "target.descriptor", "activityAction", "tenant_name" as Time, %"System User", Task, Target, ActivityAction, tenant_name nodrop
| timeslice 1h
| where Task matches "{{Task}}" and tenant_name matches "{{TenantName}}" and %"System User" matches "{{SystemUser}}"
| if(Task matches "*Security Group*" and (ActivityAction = "WRITE"  OR Task matches "*Edit*"), 1, 0) as security_group_changes
| if(Task matches "*Report*" and (Task matches "*Edit*" or Task matches "*Delete*"  or ActivityAction = "WRITE") ,1, 0) as report_changes
| if(Task matches "*API Client*" and (ActivityAction = "WRITE" or Task matches "*Edit*" or Task matches "*Delete*"),1, 0) as api_client_changes
| if(Task matches "*Permissions*" or Task matches "*Credentials*" and (ActivityAction = "WRITE" or Task matches "*Edit*" or Task matches "*Delete*"), 1, 0) as permission_changes
| if(Task matches "*Policy*", 1, 0) as policy_events
| if(Task matches "*Business*" and Task matches "*Object*", 1, 0) as business_object_events
| if(Task = "Create Condition Rule" or Task = "Reassign Tasks" or Task = "Create Alert Rule" or Task matches "*Business Process*", 1, 0) as business_process_events
| sum(security_group_changes) as %"Security Group Changes", sum(report_changes) as %"Report Changes", sum(api_client_changes) as %"Api Client Changes", sum(permission_changes) as %"Permission Changes", sum(policy_events) as %"Policy Events", sum(business_object_events) as %"Business Object Events", sum(business_process_events) as %"Business Process Events" by _timeslice

| json "requestTime", "systemAccount", "taskDisplayName", "target.descriptor", "activityAction", "tenant_name" as Time, %"System User", Task, Target, ActivityAction, tenant_name nodrop

| where Task matches "{{Task}}" and tenant_name matches "{{TenantName}}" and %"System User" matches "{{SystemUser}}"

queries.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/Workday*
| json "ipAddress", "systemAccount", "taskDisplayName", "activityAction", "deviceType", "tenant_name" as ipAddress, %"System User", Task, ActivityAction, DeviceType, tenant_name nodrop
| where ipAddress matches "{{IPAddress}}" and !(%"System User" matches "wd-*") and tenant_name matches "{{TenantName}}" and %"System User" matches "{{SystemUser}}" and Task matches "{{Task}}" and ActivityAction matches "{{ActivityAction}}"
 | lookup type, actor, raw, threatlevel as malicious_confidence, threat from sumo://threat/cs on threat=ipAddress
| where  type="ip_address" and !isNull(malicious_confidence)
| json field=raw "malware_families[*]" as threat_malware_families nodrop
| json field=raw "last_updated" as last_updated nodrop
| formatDate(fromseconds(last_updated), "MM-dd-yyyy") as %"Threat Last Updated" 
| json field=raw "labels[*].name" as label_name nodrop
| replace(label_name, "\\/","->") as label_name
| replace(label_name, "\""," ") as label_name
| where !(label_name matches "*TorProxy*")
| if (isEmpty(actor), "Unassigned", actor) as actor
| malicious_confidence as %"Malicious Confidence"
| ipAddress as %"Malicious IP"
| DeviceType as %"Device Type"
| actor as %"Malicious Actor"
| count as %"Count" by %"System User", %"Malicious IP", Task, %"Device Type", %"Malicious Actor", %"Malicious Confidence", %"Threat Last Updated"
| sort by %"Count"
